Troubleshooting · 01/50 · planning

Incomplete production brief

Failure signal

A incomplete production brief condition is reported or detected during planning.

Likely cause

The controlling record, technical state or approved specification for planning does not match the current asset or workflow.

Verification

Compare objectives, audience, formats, rights, budget and approvers against the signed brief.

Corrective action

Freeze the missing decisions in a dated brief revision before estimating or scheduling.

Prevention

Add this verification to the planning gate, retain immutable evidence and assign one accountable owner.
